name: NEOTH Weekly Stats
description: Inactive template. Each Sunday at 18:00 local time it renders NEOTH's available lifetime activity counters into a weekly snapshot, archives the report to the configured n8n file mount, then queues it through an operator-configured NEOTH channel.

nodes.name: Schedule (Sun 18:00)
nodes.notes: Runs at 18:00 each Sunday in the n8n instance timezone after this inactive template is explicitly activated.

nodes.name: Operator Configuration
nodes.notes: Set neothBaseUrl to an address reachable from the n8n runtime, then set the channel and its channel-native recipient. Bind an HTTP Header Auth credential containing Authorization: Bearer <NEOTH n8n API token> on every NEOTH HTTP node. archiveDirectory is n8n's default file-node allowlist path; persist it with a separate host mount before enabling this archive workflow. The current managed runtime does not provide that mount.

nodes.name: NEOTH Stats
nodes.notes: GET /api/stats returns NEOTH's available lifetime counters only: events_total, provider_requests, channel_inbound, and channel_outbound. It has no weekly-window query contract.

nodes.name: NEOTH Provider Call (format snapshot)
nodes.notes: POST /api/provider/call formats only the data returned by NEOTH Stats. Incognito prevents this automated prompt from contributing communication-profile evidence.

nodes.name: Convert report to archive file
nodes.notes: Converts the provider envelope's data.completion text into binary property data. This exact sourceProperty supports dot notation in pinned n8n 2.40.5.

nodes.name: Write report to archive
nodes.notes: Writes binary property data after conversion. archiveDirectory must be a separately mounted persistent directory within n8n's file-node allowlist; it must not be the protected .n8n configuration directory.

nodes.name: Send archived snapshot via NEOTH channel

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ channel: $('Operator Configuration').first().json.channel, recipient: $('Operator Configuration').first().json.recipient, text: 'Weekly NEOTH snapshot archived.\n\n' + $('NEOTH Provider Call (format snapshot)').first().json.data.completion }) }}

nodes.notes: Runs only after the archive write succeeds. The body reads the named provider node because the file-write response does not retain the provider envelope. NEOTH queues channel delivery; delivery itself needs a separate runtime check.

main.node: Send archived snapshot via NEOTH channel
